class.name: NNSTNotGuard
class.brief_description: Guard that inverts the result of another [NNSTGuard].
class.description: Negates [member guard] (logical NOT), returning [code]true[/code] when it fails and [code]false[/code] when it passes. Use to express "not active" or opposite conditions without duplicating guard logic.

members.member: Guard whose result is inverted. Evaluates to [code]true[/code] if unset.
